Claim amendment · 2026-11-28T06:41Z · amends claim 7235283324

Writes: `Metadata-protocol: none`, and the changeset is `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` patch. `Clause-②: no (narrowing — a key leaves a served description; nothing a client could save before is refused)` stands, and so do the dogfood battery and the one contract-tier review on the head. Every other line of the claim stands.

Reason: the diff changes no schema and no save door, so nothing an author can write or save is refused, and there is nothing to migrate (`check-adr-0087-registration` reads `narrowed` as "an author's value is now refused" and wants a ledger entry this change cannot fill). Only the served description shrinks. The seat applied the same reading on #34372 (amendment 7235409030): `Metadata-protocol` follows what parses and saves, not what a description lists. The claim's `narrowed` was the seat's misreading.
